# Data Source: stripe_apps_secret

A secret a Stripe App keeps in the Secret Store. Look one up by its `name` and `scope`, such as `{ type = "account" }`. The `payload` is sensitive and is stored in the state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_apps_secret" "api_token" {
  name = "api_token"
  scope = {
    type = "account"
  }
}

output "api_token" {
  value     = data.stripe_apps_secret.api_token.payload
  sensitive = true
}
```

## Argument Reference

This data source supports the following arguments:

* `name` - (Required) A name for the secret that's unique within the scope.
* `scope` - (Required) See [`scope`](#scope) below.

<a id="scope"></a>
### `scope`

The `scope` attribute supports:

* `type` - (Optional) The secret scope type. Possible values: `account`, `user`.
* `user` - (Optional) The user ID, if type is set to "user"

## Attribute Reference

This data source exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `created` - Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
* `deleted` - If true, indicates that this secret has been deleted
* `expires_at` - The Unix timestamp for the expiry time of the secret, after which the secret deletes.
* `id` - Unique identifier for the object.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
* `payload` - (Sensitive) The plaintext secret value to be stored.
